message.Title: Public Preview: Microsoft Defender for Cloud support for Azure Container Apps (Serverless Containers Posture)

Body.Content:
Customers can now bring Azure Container Apps environments into Microsoft Defender for Cloud’s Serverless Containers Posture experience, helping security teams extend posture management across more of their container estate from a single workflow. This makes it easier to gain visibility into Container Apps resources and assess risks across areas such as identity, networking, and container or image configuration. 

With this capability, teams can more consistently evaluate risk across container environments and use attack path analysis to identify potential exposure faster. The result is a more unified security posture, less manual effort, and stronger confidence when securing Container Apps deployments. 

Learn more.
